data.title: Council probes doctor over 30-baht scheme 'insults'
data.description: <p>The Medical Council is reviewing allegations that a doctor insulted a patient and disparaged people using the state's 30-baht universal healthcare scheme, its secretary-general said yesterday.</p>

data.title: Three's a crowd at Championship summit
data.description: <p>Although it is very early days in the English season, there is already quite a scrap going on at the top of the Championship with an unlikely trio leading the way.</p>

data.title: Antonsen makes it three wins in a row over Kunlavut
data.description: <p>Kunlavut Vitidsarn bowed out in the quarter-finals of the US$1.25 million BWF China Masters in Shenzhen yesterday as all Thai players exited the Super 750 tournament at the last-eight stage.</p>

data.title: Police arrest SK Lucky Nine gang suspect
data.description: <p>A key member of an alleged South Korean investment fraud network known as Lucky Nine was arrested in Nonthaburi on Thursday after spending nearly a year in hiding in Thailand, police said.</p>

data.title: Khon Kaen Hospital reverses deficits
data.description: <p>KHON KAEN: The Ministry of Public Health has hailed Khon Kaen Hospital's turnaround after a decade of deficits as a model for state hospitals, and aims to end severe hospital debt by next year.</p>

data.title: Singaporean fugitive held
data.description: <p>A Singaporean fugitive who allegedly ordered highly toxic substances through the dark web was arrested at a condominium in Bangkok's Bang Khae district on Thursday, with police also seizing crystal methamphetamine, hazardous chemicals and ignition devices.</p>

data.title: A high-stakes gamble for all
data.description: <p>The Upper House collusion case could threaten Anutin's government &mdash; and the opposition pursuing it&ensp;v&ensp;Sept 14 decision by the EC could reshape Senate controversy and the political landscape.</p>

data.title: Weekly cabinet talk show starts today
data.description: <p>The government will launch a new weekly programme, Talk With The Anutin Cabinet, today, giving ministers a platform to explain their policies, work and plans directly to the public.</p>

data.title: Working class heroes
data.description: <p>The Japanese roots band Minyo Crusaders burst onto the international music scene in 2017 with their delightful album Echoes Of Japan on P-Vine Records.</p>

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Sept 5
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: A dim spark
data.description: <p>Looking out from the balcony of a 300-year-old fireworks factory, three teenagers ponder the future of their coastal hometown as a redevelopment project threatens to cut through the land. A New Dawn follows their race against time to set off the family's "magical" firework. Despite being a visual feat, the anime lacks narrative momentum to move it forward.</p>

data.title: Siwa strike puts Kingdom on the cusp
data.description: <p>Thailand moved three points clear at the top of Group F in the AFC U20 Asian Cup China 2027 Qualifiers on Thursday night with a 1-0 win over Turkmenistan at Chonburi Stadium.</p>

data.title: Govt 'stalling' Senate poll probe, PP says
data.description: <p>The main opposition People's Party has accused the government of deliberately delaying parliamentary scrutiny of the Election Commission's (EC) handling of alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.</p>

data.title: Anutin urges diplomats to open new opportunities
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has urged diplomats to help open investment, technology and market opportunities as Thailand shifts towards future industries.</p>

data.title: Data centres face curbs
data.description: <p>Deputy Prime Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has given the new National Data Centre Policy Committee one month to draft nationwide rules covering power and water use, urban planning, and environmental safeguards. The rules are intended to protect the public without deterring investment.</p>

data.title: 'No evidence' links ministers to scheme
data.description: <p>Police investigating alleged fraud in local government examinations have found no evidence linking any minister in the current government to the scheme, saying the claim was based solely on hearsay and lacked credibility.</p>

data.title: NBTC warned over  court case coverage
data.description: <p>The Office of the Administrative Court has warned the NBTC over parts of a press release issued after a recent case.</p>

data.title: WHO says key warehouse destroyed by attack in Ukraine
data.description: GENEVA - The World Health Organization said Friday that one of its main warehouses in Ukraine had been destroyed in air attack -- the third such incident in three months.

data.title: 5 EU countries aim to send rejected migrants to 'return hub' by 2027
data.description: COPENHAGEN - Five EU countries are seeking a deal with a country outside the bloc to host a "return hub" for migrants whose asylum applications have been rejected, with a targeted start date of January 1, a Danish minister said Friday.

data.title: Trump says envoys taking plan to 'end the war' to Moscow, Kyiv
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump said Friday that he was sending envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff to Moscow and Kyiv with a proposal to end the four-year-old Ukraine war.
